plan: An armoured fighter who locks you alone with him in another dimension to duel you.
aSurveiller: His R (Realm of Death). He takes you where your allies can't help you and steals part of your stats: keep your health high.
contrer: Dodge his Q: it deals much more damage when it hits only one target.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: his W heals him.
If his R takes you, use all your escape and protection spells, and move away from him.
forces: Very strong in duels thanks to his R.
Shield and healing with his W.
faiblesses: Slow spells that are easy to dodge.
Vulnerable to champions who kite him.

sorts.P: After 3 attacks or spells, he gains a damage aura and speed.
sorts.Q: Mace strike, stronger on an isolated target.
sorts.W: Shield he can turn into healing.
sorts.E: Pulls in every enemy in an area.
sorts.R: Locks you alone with him and steals part of your stats.

momentFort: Solid from the start, and very dangerous from level 6 with his R.
